name: Magicano Fan Disc ~ Jan Ken Pon tte Majidesuka?~
original_name: マジカノ ファンディスク ～じゃんけんぽんってマジですか?～
source:
A rock-paper-scissors ADV inspired by the manga and anime.

Ayumi Mamiya is a cursed witch to lose her powers and only one boy can break the spell. Haruo Yoshikawa thinks he is a normal boy, but unknown to him his three sisters have magical powers and keep him protected and ignorant about the existence of magic. Now Ayumi must wake up Haruo's latent powers to save himself, but his sisters will have none of that.

[from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magikano]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
受漫画和动画启发的石头剪刀布ADV。

间宫步美是一位被诅咒的女巫，她失去了力量，只有一个男孩可以打破这个咒语。吉川春夫认为他是一个正常的男孩，但他不知道他的三个姐妹拥有神奇的力量，并让他受到保护，对魔法的存在一无所知。现在步美必须唤醒春夫的潜在力量来拯救自己，但他的姐妹们却对此一无所知。

[来自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magikano]维基百科[/url]]
